'''Premiere Limited Starter Deck''' (printed as a 60 card starter set) is a 60-card [[Premiere Limited]] product published by [[Decipher]] in December 1995. MSRP was $9.95. Each starter mixes Light and Dark Premiere Limited cards plus a rulebook. Titles vary by pack. A display held 12 starters.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).</ref>
